sky cinema thriller.title: Now You See Me

sky cinema thriller.desc: Based on three hybridising narrative strands, three groups of villains are intent on retrieving a missing diamond. While Macha puts out an order on Jake's life, Jake meets brothers Avi and Zach who protect him and plot to take Macha down.

sky cinema thriller.title: Nightcrawler

sky cinema greats.desc: A group of petty criminals plan to rig a major traffic jam to divert attention from their bank heist.

Before opening the attraction to the public, he invites a top palaeontologist, palaeobotanist, mathematician/theorist, and his two eager grandchildren to experience the park. Their park visit is anything but tranquil as the park's security system breaks down, and the prehistoric creatures break out.

sky cinema greats.title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
sky cinema greats.desc: Sequel in which the entrepreneur who genetically engineered the dinosaurs in Jurassic Park transpires to have cloned more of the prehistoric monsters on another island location. Researchers arrive to observe the creatures in their natural habitat, but hot on their heels is a band of mercenaries intent on capturing the dinosaurs and transporting them back to San Diego Zoo.

sky cinema greats.title: Bad Boys
sky cinema greats.desc: Two wisecracking Miami cops are forced to swap identities in order to track down $100 million of heroin stolen from the police. Their only lead is a young woman who can identify the culprits, but when they track her down, she mistakes one of the cops for his partner, forcing the pair into a bizarre and chaotic life swap.

sky cinema greats.title: Godzilla
sky cinema greats.desc: Effects-laden blockbuster about a huge reptile which emerges from the sea to wreak havoc in Manhattan. On a research trip to Chernobyl, a young scientist discovers a startling link between genetic mutation and radioactivity. When a fishing trawler is attacked by an unseen creature, and other evidence of a massive reptilian creature is unearthed, he realises that the creature is following a destructive path to New York.

sky cinema greats.title: The Mummy
sky cinema greats.desc: The curse of an ancient mummy protects buried treasure in the Egyptian desert. An American mercenary who knows of the secret location is rescued from a Cairo prison by an English historian and her brother, and together they set off on a hunt. Along the way, the trio encounter flesh-eating scarab beetles, killer sandstorms, and reincarnated demons.

sky cinema drama.title: Dreamgirls
sky cinema drama.desc: Following the adventures of The Dreamettes, an all-girl singing group. He persuades them to become backing singers for James `Thunder' Early, but the larger-than-life lead singer Effie White must step out of the spotlight in favour of the more image-friendly Deena Jones.

sky cinema drama.title: The Pursuit of Happyness
